features: Screenless activity tracker for heart rate, steps, distance, calories, sleep and other supported health and fitness metrics.
Sensors include an optical heart rate monitor, 3-axis accelerometer and gyroscope, red and infrared SpO2 sensors, and a device temperature sensor.
Up to 7 days of battery life, approximately 90-minute full charging time, and quick charging for about 1 day of use in 5 minutes.
Water resistant up to 50 metres and designed for comfortable daily wear with a lightweight tracker body.
Compatible with supported Android 11.0 or later and iOS 16.4 or later smartphones through the Google Health app and Bluetooth LE.
description: Google Fitbit Air is a screenless fitness and health activity tracker designed for continuous wear. It includes an optical heart rate monitor, 3-axis accelerometer and gyroscope, red and infrared sensors for SpO2 monitoring, and a device temperature sensor. The tracker stores up to 7 days of detailed motion data and provides up to 7 days of battery life. It is water resistant up to 50 metres and connects to compatible Android and iOS smartphones using Bluetooth LE with the Google Health app.
